sentences.translation: A lunchman wears a white apron and white hat.
The apron is large and the hat is large.
A lunchman snoops a tray from the kitchen.
On the tray, there is rice, soup and side dishes.
But the lunchman is very hard at work.
Everyone in the class sits in the classroom.
A lunchman hands out trays to everyone in his class.
Before I say "I'll take care of you," I'll wait for you.
Then he began to eat cucumbers.
There is a child who says, "This side dish is delicious."
Some children say, "This is a bad idea."
But everyone seems to be very happy.
"It's time for you to have a meal."
A lunchman snatches a tray and a box in the kitchen.
Every day, I eat school rye.
